description:
Auto data card — Layer 7. Provenance + IAA + coverage +
per-annotator quality + transitivity + qualification stats in
one synthesized markdown audit artefact.

Format: 'markdown' (default) or 'json' for structured summary.

api_key is optional on the public endpoint; on /mcp/mcp a missing
key is refused.
